frame.png.tint: White. Centre already translucent; multiply overall alpha only deliberately. Header/footer text must avoid each 56 px corner square.

toggle.png.tint: White. Radio is baked in the fixed left strip; keep height 72. Scale the entire control uniformly for other UI scales.

toggle-selected.png.tint: White. Radio is baked in the fixed left strip; keep height 72. Scale the entire control uniformly for other UI scales.

slot.png.tint: White or muted gold. Centre is completely transparent; place native item above this image.

shield.png.tint: Multiply RGB by player colour; alpha unchanged. Every visible pixel is grayscale. No letters or player name baked in.

chapter-deeds.png.tint: Light ivory ink. White default; amber (#ffcf80) multiply for selection. Readable at 32 px.

chapter-company.png.tint: Light ivory ink. White default; amber (#ffcf80) multiply for selection. Readable at 32 px.

thread.png.tint: White. Decorative direction only, never magnitude. Uniform scale only; may flip horizontally.

meter-track.png.tint: White. Keep fill inset by 3 px.

meter-fill.png.tint: Neutral grayscale base: multiply by PanelLook.Tone(damageType). Poison green, fire red-orange, other types per damage-colors.json preview fallback. Do not apply amber globally. Geometry must be data-scaled; hide at zero. At widths below 5 px clip a minimum-width sprite.

hearthwoven-logo.png.tint: Keep white. Joost logo (flame mark + wordmark), drawn 188 x 60 in the header; a 2x texture with a 2 px clear margin, straight alpha with the edge colour bled into transparent texels.
